summary: Declare PyYAML and widen the Rich range so a clean wheel install works

delivery.outcome: Fix the packaging metadata so `pip install monag` yields a working command. src/monag/audit.py imports yaml, but pyyaml was never declared, so a clean wheel install crashed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml' on `monag audit`/`resume`/`export`/`panel`. Also widen rich to >=14,<16: the pin excluded rich 15, which is what the CI executor environment resolves, while the suite passes against it.
nonGoals: No source or behaviour change -- this is packaging metadata only.
Does not publish 0.3.0 to PyPI (GitHub #13, still gated by publish_enabled: false).
Complexity is declared M only because the delivery policy's M profile is the smallest class permitting two runtime-dependency declarations; the diff itself is two lines of packaging metadata.

architecture.decision: Declare the already-imported pyyaml as a runtime dependency (>=6,<7) and relax rich from >=14,<15 to >=14,<16, verified by building the wheel and running the full suite against it in a clean virtualenv with rich 15.0.0 and PyYAML 6.0.3 installed.
architecture.rollback: Revert the packaging slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Wheel installed into a clean virtualenv (rich 15.0.0, PyYAML 6.0.3) runs `monag --help` and passes 111/111 tests against the installed package, while the pre-fix dependency set reproduces ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml'.
